topic: RAII and resource lifecycle management in concurrent or multi-consumer code
principle: Resource ownership and lifetime must be explicit and traceable. Use RAII wrappers with reference counting or explicit lifecycle tokens to ensure resources outlive all consumers, preventing premature cleanup and use-after-free bugs.
instruction: When implementing resources shared across threads, tasks, or consumers (such as database connections, file handles, network sockets, or in-memory caches), ensure the resource cannot be dropped while any consumer still holds a reference or token to it.
